question: Which selected-record field identifies a manual save slot, and where can a host ruleset sidecar be checked before load and committed after save success?

dependencies.use: Provides the selected-user resolver, selected device field, content enumeration owner, and 0x164 UI record stride.

currentEvidence.method: foreground read-only Ghidra queries, narrow generated-code comparison, hook-placement tests, and a default-off runtime load/overwrite matrix
currentEvidence.qualification: The runtime matrix observed one existing manual slot, save0.sve. Other manual and autosave identifiers retain the same statically proved field contract but were not individually exercised.

slotIdentity.result: Both manual save and manual load owners derive the storage name from the selected content record at offset 0x108. The runtime probe observed the same normalized NUL-terminated identifier on load and overwrite-save.
slotIdentity.boundary: Use the filename only inside the selected user/device content namespace; filename alone is not a process-global key.

loadBoundary.result: Function entry receives the selected content record before content open and before the native deserializer call, so a missing or mismatched sidecar can stop the load without modifying native save data.
loadBoundary.boundary: A mismatch policy and owner-facing warning UI remain implementation work.

saveBoundary.result: The serializer result is combined with file-finalization status before 0x82D829E8. The result and selected internal filename remain live there, so a host sidecar can be atomically committed only when r25 is nonzero.
saveBoundary.boundary: Failure and device-removal outcomes were not forced; the static branch keeps them distinguishable from success.

sidecarContract.key: selected user/device content namespace plus the normalized internal filename from record offset 0x108
sidecarContract.loadRule: Resolve and compare the sidecar at 0x82D84238 before native content open or deserialization.
sidecarContract.saveRule: Write a temporary host sidecar and atomically replace the namespaced sidecar only after 0x82D829E8 reports success.
sidecarContract.result: The mapped edges support host-only ruleset identity without embedding metadata in the native save.

guards: Do not use the display label as the sidecar key.
Do not use the internal filename without its selected user/device content namespace.
Do not commit a sidecar before file finalization succeeds.
Do not infer manual-load success from slot selection or content enumeration.
Do not edit or append to the native save format.
conclusion: Version 1.3 exposes a stable namespaced slot identifier at selected content record offset 0x108, a pre-load intervention point at 0x82D84238, and a finalized save-result edge at 0x82D829E8. Runtime load and overwrite-save both reported save0.sve, with the save result successful.
